name: MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff_single_add_eq
source:
private lemma hasseCoeff_single_add_eq {i : σ} {n : ℕ} {k' : σ →₀ ℕ} (hi : k' i = 0) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    hasseCoeff d (Finsupp.single i n + k') = n.choose (d i) * hasseCoeff (d.erase i) k' := by
  classical
  rw [hasseCoeff, ← Finsupp.mul_prod_erase' d i _ (by simp), hasseCoeff]
  congr 1
  · simp [hi]
  · refine Finsupp.prod_congr fun j hj ↦ ?_
    rw [Finsupp.support_erase] at hj
    simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]

what: Splits a multivariate binomial factor into one coordinate's binomial coefficient and the factor on the erased multi-index.
how: Uses Finsupp.mul_prod_erase' to extract the selected coordinate; all other coordinates are unchanged because the added one-coordinate term vanishes there.
hypotheses: Natural multi-indices with the residual exponent zero at the selected coordinate; no coefficient-semiring assumption.
